cohort: The study included women carrying a preterm FGR fetus and women with an appropriately grown fetus matched at the same gestational age.
finding: Four microRNAs (miR-16-5p, miR-103-3p, miR-107-3p, and miR-27b-3p) were identified as possible candidates for diagnosing FGR, showing varying expression patterns depending on gestational age.
cross-section timing: Before the 32nd week of gestation and between the 32nd and 37th week of gestation.
gest_age: Samples collected before 32nd week of gestation and between 32nd and 37th week of gestation; participants included women carrying a preterm FGR fetus and women with an appropriately grown fetus matched at the same gestational age.
